A box of soft pastels: six sticks, colourful and playful, each greyed back so it
reads as chalk rather than as candy.
Toggle the colour scheme to see the inversion: on light paper the pastels are
tints and the deep hues carry the text, and on the dark ground the pastels
become the ink.

## Links and text

A [link](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-pastel) is drawn in mint, deep on
paper and chalk on night.

## Tints

::: {.callout-note}
Note takes a sky wash behind Quarto's own left edge.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
Tip takes mint.
:::

::: {.callout-caution}
Caution takes lemon.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Important takes coral.
:::

> A blockquote is washed in mint with a solid left edge.
